# cascade-miner

> Harness for competing on the Bittensor **cascade** subnet (netuid 91, finney).
> We submit a purely-algorithmic synthetic time-series generator; the subnet
> owner trains one fixed forecaster on our corpus and scores it against the
> reigning king's on a private, rotating held-out set. Model, seeds,
> initialisation and compute are identical on both sides — **the generator is
> the only variable.**

Read this file first if you are an agent joining cold; it is a map, not the
authority. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are the operating instructions and win
over anything here. Where prose disagrees with `notes/upstream-state.json`, the
snapshot is right — it is generated from the reference clone, prose is not.

Four rules that cost money or a round when broken:

- **Never** rent a pod, create or register a hotkey, or submit on-chain.
  Request it through `runs/agent-request.json` (or the `request_action` tool)
  and let the controller's approval gate decide. Never touch wallet secrets.
- **Never** edit the read-only Cascade reference clone at `$CASCADE_DIR`
  (default `/root/cascade`). Pull and reinstall it; never modify it.
- A hotkey that enters a heat is **burned** — submissions are one-shot and cost
  a re-registration. Screen and score locally first.
- State the seed count and noise floor with every number, and say plainly when
  a result is null. A difference inside the noise floor is not a finding.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the operating brief — environment, privilege
  boundary, agent backends, and the typed MCP tool surface.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the same contract in rule form, plus the method
  discipline every experiment is held to.
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing setup, the full loop, and the failure
  modes that have actually cost rounds.
- [docs/SETUP.md](docs/SETUP.md): first-time host setup.

## What we are competing on

- [notes/CONTRACT.md](notes/CONTRACT.md): the submission contract distilled —
  hard requirements, round mechanics, warm start, deploy protection.
- [notes/BUDGET.md](notes/BUDGET.md): how the training budget is derived.
- [notes/METHOD.md](notes/METHOD.md): canonical, result-free evaluation
  method — pairing, component storage, controls, screening, per-source
  diagnosis.
- [notes/EXPERIMENTS.md](notes/EXPERIMENTS.md): what has been tried, with
  hypotheses and outcomes.
- [notes/UPSTREAM.md](notes/UPSTREAM.md) and
  [notes/upstream-state.json](notes/upstream-state.json): **generated** from
  the reference clone by `scripts/upstream_state.py`. Never hand-edit them.

## The code

- [miner/screen.py](miner/screen.py): free pre-GPU screen of a candidate corpus
  against the king's — contract gates, per-feature dose in units of the
  generator's own seed noise, coverage traded away, and claim carriage. Rules
  spending out; never predicts a duel.
- [miner/campaign.py](miner/campaign.py): goal-driven loop — improve → screen →
  gated eval → verdict with measured feedback per pass, until the candidate is
  competitive or a budget/stall/deadline stops it. Never rents or submits.
- [miner/evaluate.py](miner/evaluate.py): train one arm at one seed, saving the
  per-window score components the verdict is computed from.
- [miner/analyze.py](miner/analyze.py): geomean plus the paired
  cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound against the king.
- [miner/controller.py](miner/controller.py): watches upstream and round
  receipts, triggers improvement passes, owns the approval queue.
- [miner/mcp_server.py](miner/mcp_server.py): the harness as MCP tools —
  `get_brief`, `miner_status`, `run_quick_verify`, `screen_candidate`,
  `fetch_generator`, `log_experiment`, `report_issue`, `request_action`.
- [miner/submit.py](miner/submit.py), [miner/rounds.py](miner/rounds.py):
  deploy path and the real commit deadline (reveal minus a safety buffer, not
  the epoch boundary).
- [generators/candidate](generators/candidate): the deployable submission —
  exactly `generator.py`, `config.json`, `requirements.txt`.

## Orientation commands

All read-only, all free:

```bash
bash scripts/setup.sh --check                     # setup, verified in place
.venv/bin/python -m miner.status --doctor --json  # checklist with a fix per stage
.venv/bin/python scripts/quick_verify.py generators/candidate
.venv/bin/python -m miner.screen generators/candidate --king generators/king-control
```

## Optional

- [schemas/](schemas/): file contracts for agent requests, approvals, the
  experiment ledger, and the issue tracker.
- [skills/cascade-miner/SKILL.md](skills/cascade-miner/SKILL.md): the same
  operating context packaged for sessions that load skills.
- [ops/](ops/): operator-owned wallet wrappers. Agents never invoke these.
